key_contacts.name: Inspector Bren
key_contacts.notes: Observed Corin recover the Cinder Ledger at 07:00; waiting at Pier Seven for documented cargo proof before midday.

key_contacts.name: Tomas Vesper
key_contacts.notes: Maren Vesper's estranged nephew. Worked the dawn tally desk when The Redwing fouled the Outer Boom.

key_contacts.name: Elena Reed
key_contacts.notes: Tested the wheelhouse soot and confirmed pine pitch with lamp-oil accelerant; mentioned buying cheap tallow from a frightened deckhand two nights ago.

rival_houses_and_factions.name: House Merrow
rival_houses_and_factions.status: Representative: Captain Kestrel (at Counting House Gate)
rival_houses_and_factions.notes: Captain Kestrel and two deckhands just intercepted Corin at the Counting House Gate, demanding to inspect what burned aboard The Redwing.

rival_houses_and_factions.name: House Vesper
rival_houses_and_factions.status: Representative: Maren Vesper (at Counting House Gate)
rival_houses_and_factions.notes: Maren Vesper and two factor-guards have blocked the Pier Seven lane after spotting the charred Cinder Ledger in Corin's satchel.

transient_contacts.name: Barge-Hand Pell
transient_contacts.notes: Reported seeing two strangers in dry oilskins pay silver to ferry three quiet sailors ashore upriver before dawn, and noted a grey-coated Vesper tally-boy buying silence on the quay.

transient_contacts.name: Yard-Clerk Davin
transient_contacts.notes: Took two silver marks to hand over a discarded #P7-088 bonded-salt transfer slip and matching crimson wax flake from the counting house yard.
